metadata.title:
Sparse Attention Routing for
Long-Context Language Models

authors.name: Aiko  Tanaka
authors.affiliation: Graduate School of Information Science, Tohoku University

authors.name: Marcus Feldman
authors.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, ETH Zurich

metadata.abstract: Long-context language models suffer from quadratic attention cost. We propose a routing mechanism that selects a sparse subset of key-value pairs per query head.

sections.heading: 1 Introduction
sections.text:
Transformer-based language models have scaled context windows from 2K to over 1M tokens.  

The attention mechanism remains quadratic in sequence length.

sections.heading: 3.1 Routing Function
sections.text: Given a query vector q and a set of key vectors K, the router computes a relevance score.
